Get grid square statistics of the Population Census

Source: R/census-grid-get.R
census_grid_get.Rd

Returns a table of the grid square statistics (地域メッシュ統計) of the Population Census, one row per grid square with residents, as published. The first call for a table downloads its files from e-Stat (by primary grid square) and builds it, which is then cached.

Usage

census_grid_get(year, grid_size, table_code)

Source

Statistics Bureau of Japan, grid square statistics of the Population Census (国勢調査に関する地域メッシュ統計), from e-Stat: https://www.e-stat.go.jp/gis. The terms of use of e-Stat, based on the Standard Terms of Use of the Government of Japan (Version 2.0) and compatible with CC BY 4.0, are on https://www.e-stat.go.jp/terms-of-use.

Arguments

year

The year of the census: 2010, 2015, or 2020.

grid_size

The size of the grid squares: one of grid_sizes(). There is no default, as the size is a choice of the model.

table_code

The number of the table (統計表), such as "001-01". See census_grid_tables() for the tables of each year and size.

Value

A tibble with one row per grid square:

  • year: The year of the census (integer), as of October 1.

  • release: The year of the release the values are taken from (integer). It is year.

  • grid_code: The code of the grid square (see grid_city_get()).

  • suppression_code: The suppression of the square (秘匿処理), as published: 0 not suppressed, 1 a square that includes suppressed squares (合算地域), and 2 a suppressed square (秘匿地域). NA for 2010, whose tables have no suppression.

  • merged_into_grid_code: For a suppressed square, the square that includes its values (合算先), otherwise NA.

  • One integer column per item, named by its code, as published (for example T001141001 for 人口（総数）). Suppressed values are NA. See census_grid_items() for the names and units of the items.

Details

The census of each year is its own release. Grid squares have fixed boundaries, so squares of different years compare directly. Squares without residents have no row.

Small squares are suppressed (秘匿), except for the population by sex and the number of households: their other values are NA, and they are added to another square (merged_into_grid_code), whose values then include them.

The first time in a session, the terms of use are shown. Published or processed data must credit the source (the grid square statistics of the Population Census by the Statistics Bureau of Japan), and processed data must say that they were processed.

See also

census_grid_target() to declare the table as a target.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
census_grid_get(2020, "500m", "001-01")
}
